other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence of at least five years.
The book must be a first edition published between 1 January and 31 December of the year considered.
The work must be creative literature of the author’s own making and cannot be an abridged, imitation, translated version, or synopsis of another book.
Literary critics, thesis research presented for university degrees or examinations are not eligible.
An author who has received the award cannot apply for the next four consecutive years.
The submitted book must not have been awarded by any other government, non‑government, or voluntary literary organization.
benefits_summary: Each award carries a financial assistance of ₹10,000, with a total of ten awards given annually.
